activity_summary: You stood in the porch through two turns of the glass. Fourteenthly was his heading, and you did not bring a sermon home. Sir John was in his pew and added nothing. You said the book would gain no cross for today. Mistress Ansell counted the turns and took you toward dinner.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Turned the glass twice, and stopped.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Counted the turns, and aimed you at dinner.

entities.name: Sir John Spencer
entities.context: Sat his pew, and added nothing.

facets.activity: Stood through two turns of the glass

quotes.speaker: josias_thwaite
quotes.text: Two turns of the glass, and fourteenthly is where I am bound

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The book at home has no cross for today

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: Two turns. I counted them so I would know when to stand.
